name: Two curl terminals on ashu-mac
description: Open two independent shell sessions on the remote agent 'ashu-mac' (each cap.shell_exec is its own subprocess, i.e. its own 'terminal'), run one curl in each, and let each command's response (exit_code/stdout/stderr) flow back to the server as that node's recorded output. The two nodes share no edge, so they run concurrently.
rationale: Example: two parallel cap.shell_exec 'terminals' on a named remote agent. Each curl's output returns to the server automatically via the result frame and is recorded as the node output, so no explicit send-back node is needed. Swap the URLs in each argv for the calls you actually want to make.
